svg.title: nf-core/rnaseq: runs got 57% cheaper, the idle share barely moved
svg.desc: Stacked columns for 30 nf-core/rnaseq star_salmon releases, 3.1 to 3.26.0: allocated cost per full-size AWS test run at Seqera Compute list rates, split into used and never-used allocation. Cost fell from $138.66 to $59.64; the unused share stayed between 62% and 68% in 28 of 30 releases.
